description: Source code for a PHP class 'bsd_common' that provides system information functions for BSD-based systems, including methods to read kernel messages, get system hostname, IP address, kernel version, uptime, CPU info, memory, filesystems, and device details.

classes.name: bsd_common
classes.description: A class providing system information functions for BSD systems, including methods for kernel messages, hostname, IP, kernel version, uptime, CPU, memory, device info, and filesystems.

methods.name: read_dmesg
methods.description: Reads the kernel message buffer from /var/run/dmesg.boot, parsing for reboot messages.

methods.name: grab_key
methods.description: Retrieves system control parameters using sysctl.

methods.name: hostname
methods.description: Returns the server's hostname or 'N.A.' if not available.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Returns the canonical hostname using the hostname command.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the server's IP address, resolving hostname if necessary.

methods.name: kernel
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the kernel version string.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Counts the number of logged-in users.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Retrieves system load averages, optionally including CPU load percentage.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Gathers CPU model, speed, and count from system messages.

methods.name: scsi
methods.description: Extracts SCSI device information from kernel messages.

methods.name: pci
methods.description: Extracts PCI device information from kernel messages or parsed data.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Extracts IDE device information from kernel messages.

methods.name: usb
methods.description: Placeholder for USB device detection, currently returns empty array.

methods.name: sbus
methods.description: Placeholder function, returns an array with an empty string.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Gathers memory and swap usage details, including total, free, used, and swap info.

methods.name: distro
methods.description: Returns the system distribution name via 'uname -s'.
